code:
<!--
================================================================================
FILE: MainWindow.xaml
PROJECT: RaggieSoft StoreTrainer 2.0 (StoreTrainer.csproj)
LICENSE: MIT License (Code) / CC BY-SA 4.0 (Documentation & Creative Content)

PLAIN-ENGLISH OVERVIEW (FOR A 100-LEVEL BEGINNER):
  What is this file?
    MainWindow.xaml defines the visual desktop window for RaggieSoft StoreTrainer 2.0.
    If you have built web interfaces in HTML + CSS, think of this XAML file as a
    clean, responsive 3-row CSS Grid layout:
      - Row 0 (Top App Header): StoreTrainer icon, title, live profile count,
        My StoreFiles folder buttons, Theme switcher (System / Dark / Light),
        and About & Legal Notice button.
      - Row 1 (Main Two-Column Workspace):
          * Left Sidebar: Instant search box, Category/Favorites dropdown filter,
            New Profile & Open Existing File buttons, and a live clickable list
            of every '.stf' game profile in your 'My StoreFiles' folder!
          * Right Profile Editor & Launcher: One-click 'Launch Game & Trainer'
            primary button, Save / Save As / Duplicate / Remove toolbar, Launch
            Order & Timing options, Game Program card (supports drag-and-drop!),
            Companion Trainer card with optional Trainer Safety Check, Hotkey
            Notes box, and the scrollable RaggieSoft Work of Fiction & Licensing
            notice.
      - Row 2 (Bottom Status Bar): Friendly live status message and active library
        folder readout.

  Screen-Reader & Keyboard Accessibility:
    Every interactive control carries a clear 'AutomationProperties.Name' label
    (WPF's desktop equivalent of HTML 'aria-label') for Windows Narrator, JAWS,
    and NVDA, and uses '{DynamicResource ...}' Fluent brushes so Light Mode,
    Dark Mode, and Windows High-Contrast themes all maintain crisp readability.
================================================================================
-->
<Window x:Class="StoreTrainer.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008"
        xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
        mc:Ignorable="d"
        Title="RaggieSoft StoreTrainer — PC Game & Trainer Organizer"
        Icon="Assets/StoreTrainer.png"
        Width="1240"
        Height="840"
        MinWidth="860"
        MinHeight="600"
        AllowDrop="True"
        Drop="Window_OnDrop"
        DragOver="Window_OnDragOver"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen"
        AutomationProperties.Name="RaggieSoft StoreTrainer Application">

    <!--
      OUTER 3-ROW GRID:
      - Row 0 (Auto): Top application bar
      - Row 1 (*):    Main two-column split workspace (expands to fill window height)
      - Row 2 (Auto): Bottom status bar
    -->
    <Grid Margin="14">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto" />
            <RowDefinition Height="*" />
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto" />
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

        <!-- ===================================================================
             ROW 0: TOP APPLICATION HEADER BAR
             =================================================================== -->
        <Border Grid.Row="0"
                Padding="16,11"
                CornerRadius="8"
                BorderThickness="1"
                BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                Background="{DynamicResource CardBackgroundFillColorDefaultBrush}"
                Margin="0,0,0,12">
            <DockPanel LastChildFill="False">
                <!-- Left Branding: StoreTrainer Icon + Title + Subtitle -->
                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" DockPanel.Dock="Left" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <Image Source="Assets/StoreTrainer.png"
                           Width="40"
                           Height="40"
                           Margin="0,0,14,0"
                           RenderOptions.BitmapScalingMode="HighQuality" />
                    <StackPanel VerticalAlignment="Center">
                        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                            <TextBlock Text="RaggieSoft StoreTrainer"
                                       FontSize="19"
                                       FontWeight="Bold"
                                       VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                            <Border CornerRadius="4"
                                    Padding="8,2"
                                    Margin="10,0,0,0"
                                    BorderThickness="1"
                                    BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                                    VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <TextBlock Text="Version 2.0"
                                           FontSize="11.5"
                                           FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                           Opacity="0.88" />
                            </Border>
                        </StackPanel>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="LibrarySummaryText"
                                   Text="Organize and launch your classic and modern PC games alongside their companion trainers"
                                   FontSize="12.5"
                                   Opacity="0.78"
                                   Margin="0,2,0,0" />
                    </StackPanel>
                </StackPanel>

                <!-- Right Header Actions: Library Folder, Theme Toggle, Website, About & Legal -->
                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" DockPanel.Dock="Right" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <Button x:Name="OpenLibraryFolderButton"
                            Content="📂 Open My StoreFiles"
                            Padding="11,6"
                            Margin="0,0,8,0"
                            Click="OpenLibraryFolderButton_OnClick"
                            ToolTip="Open your saved My StoreFiles folder in File Explorer"
                            AutomationProperties.Name="Open My StoreFiles Folder" />
                    <Button x:Name="ChangeLibraryFolderButton"
                            Content="📁 Choose Library Folder..."
                            Padding="11,6"
                            Margin="0,0,8,0"
                            Click="ChangeLibraryFolderButton_OnClick"
                            ToolTip="Choose a different folder for your saved StoreFiles"
                            AutomationProperties.Name="Choose StoreFiles Library Folder" />
                    <Button x:Name="ThemeToggleButton"
                            Content="🌓 Theme: System"
                            Padding="11,6"
                            Margin="0,0,8,0"
                            Click="ThemeToggleButton_OnClick"
                            AutomationProperties.Name="Switch Color Theme" />
                    <Button Content="ℹ️ About & Legal"
                            Padding="11,6"
                            Click="AboutAndLegalButton_OnClick"
                            ToolTip="About RaggieSoft StoreTrainer & Work of Fiction Notice"
                            AutomationProperties.Name="About RaggieSoft StoreTrainer and Work of Fiction Notice" />
                </StackPanel>
            </DockPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- ===================================================================
             ROW 1: MAIN TWO-COLUMN SPLIT WORKSPACE (LIBRARY SIDEBAR + EDITOR)
             =================================================================== -->
        <Grid Grid.Row="1" Margin="0,0,0,10">
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <!-- Left Column: Saved StoreFiles Library Sidebar (330 DIPs wide) -->
                <ColumnDefinition Width="335" />
                <ColumnDefinition Width="14" />
                <!-- Right Column: Selected Profile Editor & One-Click Launcher -->
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

            <!-- ...............................................................
                 LEFT COLUMN: SAVED STOREFILES LIBRARY SIDEBAR
                 ............................................................... -->
            <Border Grid.Column="0"
                    Padding="12"
                    CornerRadius="8"
                    BorderThickness="1"
                    BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                    Background="{DynamicResource CardBackgroundFillColorDefaultBrush}">
                <Grid>
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto" />
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto" />
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto" />
                        <RowDefinition Height="*" />
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                    <!-- Sidebar Action Buttons: New Profile + Open Any .stf File -->
                    <Grid Grid.Row="0" Margin="0,0,0,10">
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="8" />
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" />
                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <Button x:Name="NewProfileButton"
                                Grid.Column="0"
                                Content="➕ New Game Profile"
                                Padding="10,7"
                                FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"
                                Click="NewProfileButton_OnClick"
                                AutomationProperties.Name="Create New Game Profile" />
                        <Button x:Name="ImportProfileButton"
                                Grid.Column="2"
                                Content="📂 Open File..."
                                Padding="10,7"
                                Click="ImportProfileButton_OnClick"
                                ToolTip="Open a .stf StoreFile from anywhere on your computer"
                                AutomationProperties.Name="Open StoreFile from Computer" />
                    </Grid>

                    <!-- Instant Library Search Box -->
                    <TextBox x:Name="LibrarySearchBox"
                             Grid.Row="1"
                             Padding="8,6"
                             Margin="0,0,0,8"
                             TextChanged="LibrarySearchBox_OnTextChanged"
                             ToolTip="Search saved profiles by game title, category, or notes"
                             AutomationProperties.Name="Search Saved Game Profiles" />

                    <!-- Category & Favorites Filter Dropdown -->
                    <ComboBox x:Name="LibraryCategoryFilterCombo"
                              Grid.Row="2"
                              SelectedIndex="0"
                              Margin="0,0,0,10"
                              SelectionChanged="LibraryCategoryFilterCombo_OnSelectionChanged"
                              AutomationProperties.Name="Filter Saved Profiles by Category">
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="All Saved Profiles" Tag="ALL" />
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="★ Favorites Only" Tag="FAVORITES" />
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="General" Tag="General" />
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Action & Adventure" Tag="Action & Adventure" />
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Role-Playing (RPG)" Tag="Role-Playing (RPG)" />
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Strategy & Simulation" Tag="Strategy & Simulation" />
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Retro & Classic PC" Tag="Retro & Classic PC" />
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Sports & Racing" Tag="Sports & Racing" />
                    </ComboBox>

                    <!-- Scrollable List of Saved StoreFile Profiles -->
                    <Grid Grid.Row="3">
                        <ListBox x:Name="ProfilesListBox"
                                 SelectionChanged="ProfilesListBox_OnSelectionChanged"
                                 HorizontalContentAlignment="Stretch"
                                 ScrollViewer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled"
                                 AutomationProperties.Name="Saved StoreFiles List">
                            <ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                                <DataTemplate>
                                    <Border Padding="8,7" Margin="0,2">
                                        <StackPanel>
                                            <DockPanel LastChildFill="True">
                                                <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                                           Text="{Binding FileNameBadge}"
                                                           FontSize="10.5"
                                                           Opacity="0.65"
                                                           Margin="8,0,0,0"
                                                           VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding DisplayTitle}"
                                                           FontSize="13.5"
                                                           FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                                           TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                                            </DockPanel>
                                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding SubtitleSummary}"
                                                       FontSize="11.5"
                                                       Opacity="0.76"
                                                       Margin="0,2,0,0"
                                                       TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                                        </StackPanel>
                                    </Border>
                                </DataTemplate>
                            </ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                        </ListBox>

                        <!-- Friendly Empty-State Helper Shown When No Profiles Match -->
                        <TextBlock x:Name="EmptyLibraryText"
                                   Text="No saved game profiles yet.

Click "➕ New Game Profile" above — or drag and drop any game .exe or .stf file right onto this window to get started!"
                                   TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                   TextAlignment="Center"
                                   Opacity="0.72"
                                   FontSize="12.5"
                                   Margin="18"
                                   VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                   IsHitTestVisible="False"
                                   Visibility="Collapsed" />
                    </Grid>
                </Grid>
            </Border>

            <!-- ...............................................................
                 RIGHT COLUMN: PROFILE EDITOR & ONE-CLICK LAUNCHER
                 ............................................................... -->
            <ScrollViewer Grid.Column="2"
                          VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                          HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
                <StackPanel>

                    <!-- 1. TOP PROFILE ACTION BAR (LAUNCH, SAVE, DUPLICATE, DELETE) -->
                    <Border Padding="16,14"
                            Margin="0,0,0,12"
                            CornerRadius="8"
                            BorderThickness="1"
                            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                            Background="{DynamicResource CardBackgroundFillColorDefaultBrush}">
                        <DockPanel LastChildFill="False">
                            <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Left" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <WrapPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                    <TextBlock x:Name="ProfileHeaderTitleText"
                                               Text="Untitled Game Profile"
                                               FontSize="18"
                                               FontWeight="Bold"
                                               Margin="0,0,10,0" />
                                    <Border x:Name="UnsavedBadgeBorder"
                                            CornerRadius="4"
                                            Padding="7,2"
                                            BorderThickness="1"
                                            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                                            VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                            Visibility="Collapsed">
                                        <TextBlock Text="Unsaved Changes"
                                                   FontSize="11"
                                                   FontWeight="SemiBold" />
                                    </Border>
                                </WrapPanel>
                                <CheckBox x:Name="FavoriteCheckBox"
                                          Content="★ Pin this game to the top of my Favorites list"
                                          Margin="0,6,0,0"
                                          Checked="EditorField_OnChanged"
                                          Unchecked="EditorField_OnChanged"
                                          AutomationProperties.Name="Pin Profile as Favorite" />
                            </StackPanel>

                            <WrapPanel Orientation="Horizontal" DockPanel.Dock="Right" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <Button x:Name="LaunchNowButton"
                                        Content="▶ Launch Game & Trainer"
                                        Padding="16,9"
                                        Margin="0,0,8,0"
                                        FontWeight="Bold"
                                        Click="LaunchNowButton_OnClick"
                                        ToolTip="Save if needed and launch your game and companion trainer"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Launch Game and Trainer" />
                                <Button x:Name="SaveProfileButton"
                                        Content="💾 Save"
                                        Padding="12,9"
                                        Margin="0,0,6,0"
                                        Click="SaveProfileButton_OnClick"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Save Game Profile" />
                                <Button x:Name="SaveAsProfileButton"
                                        Content="Save As..."
                                        Padding="11,9"
                                        Margin="0,0,6,0"
                                        Click="SaveAsProfileButton_OnClick"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Save Game Profile As New File" />
                                <Button x:Name="DuplicateProfileButton"
                                        Content="📋 Duplicate"
                                        Padding="11,9"
                                        Margin="0,0,6,0"
                                        Click="DuplicateProfileButton_OnClick"
                                        ToolTip="Create a copy of this profile (handy for testing different launch options)"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Duplicate Game Profile" />
                                <Button x:Name="DeleteProfileButton"
                                        Content="🗑 Delete"
                                        Padding="11,9"
                                        Click="DeleteProfileButton_OnClick"
                                        ToolTip="Delete this saved .stf profile from your library"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Delete Game Profile" />
                            </WrapPanel>
                        </DockPanel>
                    </Border>

                    <!-- 2. GENERAL PROFILE DETAILS & LAUNCH TIMING CARD -->
                    <Border Padding="16,14"
                            Margin="0,0,0,12"
                            CornerRadius="8"
                            BorderThickness="1"
                            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                            Background="{DynamicResource CardBackgroundFillColorDefaultBrush}">
                        <StackPanel>
                            <TextBlock Text="1. Profile Name & Launch Order"
                                       FontSize="15"
                                       FontWeight="Bold"
                                       Margin="0,0,0,10" />

                            <Grid Margin="0,0,0,12">
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="2*" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="12" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="0">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Display Title (shown in your library list):"
                                               FontSize="12"
                                               Opacity="0.84"
                                               Margin="0,0,0,4" />
                                    <TextBox x:Name="ProfileDisplayNameBox"
                                             Padding="8,6"
                                             TextChanged="EditorTextBox_OnTextChanged"
                                             AutomationProperties.Name="Profile Display Title" />
                                </StackPanel>

                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="2">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Category:"
                                               FontSize="12"
                                               Opacity="0.84"
                                               Margin="0,0,0,4" />
                                    <ComboBox x:Name="ProfileCategoryCombo"
                                              IsEditable="True"
                                              Padding="8,5"
                                              SelectionChanged="ProfileCategoryCombo_OnSelectionChanged"
                                              LostFocus="ProfileCategoryCombo_OnLostFocus"
                                              AutomationProperties.Name="Profile Category">
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="General" />
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Action & Adventure" />
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Role-Playing (RPG)" />
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Strategy & Simulation" />
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Retro & Classic PC" />
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Sports & Racing" />
                                    </ComboBox>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Grid>

                            <!-- Mutually-Exclusive Launch Sequence Checkboxes + Smart Wait + Delay -->
                            <CheckBox x:Name="TrainerLaunchesGameCheckBox"
                                      Content="Trainer starts the game automatically (only launch the trainer program)"
                                      Margin="0,0,0,6"
                                      Checked="TrainerLaunchesGameCheckBox_OnChanged"
                                      Unchecked="TrainerLaunchesGameCheckBox_OnChanged"
                                      AutomationProperties.Name="Trainer Starts the Game Automatically" />

                            <CheckBox x:Name="LaunchGameFirstCheckBox"
                                      Content="Start the game first, then open the trainer after the game starts"
                                      Margin="0,0,0,6"
                                      Checked="EditorField_OnChanged"
                                      Unchecked="EditorField_OnChanged"
                                      AutomationProperties.Name="Start the Game First Before Trainer" />

                            <CheckBox x:Name="WaitForGameReadyCheckBox"
                                      Content="Wait until the first window finishes opening before starting the second program"
                                      IsChecked="True"
                                      Margin="0,0,0,10"
                                      Checked="EditorField_OnChanged"
                                      Unchecked="EditorField_OnChanged"
                                      AutomationProperties.Name="Wait Until First Window Finishes Opening" />

                            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <TextBlock Text="Extra pause between programs:"
                                           VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                           FontSize="12.5"
                                           Margin="0,0,10,0" />
                                <ComboBox x:Name="LaunchDelayCombo"
                                          Width="175"
                                          SelectedIndex="0"
                                          SelectionChanged="LaunchDelayCombo_OnSelectionChanged"
                                          AutomationProperties.Name="Extra Pause Between Programs">
                                    <ComboBoxItem Content="None (0 seconds)" Tag="0" />
                                    <ComboBoxItem Content="2 seconds" Tag="2" />
                                    <ComboBoxItem Content="5 seconds" Tag="5" />
                                    <ComboBoxItem Content="10 seconds" Tag="10" />
                                    <ComboBoxItem Content="15 seconds" Tag="15" />
                                    <ComboBoxItem Content="30 seconds" Tag="30" />
                                </ComboBox>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </Border>

                    <!-- 3. GAME PROGRAM CARD (SUPPORTS DRAGGING & DROPPING A GAME .EXE) -->
                    <Border x:Name="GameSectionBorder"
                            Padding="16,14"
                            Margin="0,0,0,12"
                            CornerRadius="8"
                            BorderThickness="1"
                            AllowDrop="True"
                            Drop="GameSectionBorder_OnDrop"
                            DragOver="Window_OnDragOver"
                            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                            Background="{DynamicResource CardBackgroundFillColorDefaultBrush}">
                        <StackPanel>
                            <DockPanel LastChildFill="False" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Left"
                                           Text="2. Game Program (you can drag and drop your game file here)"
                                           FontSize="15"
                                           FontWeight="Bold"
                                           VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                <TextBlock x:Name="GameStatusText"
                                           DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                           Text=""
                                           FontSize="12"
                                           FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                           VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                            </DockPanel>

                            <TextBlock Text="Game Program File:"
                                       FontSize="12"
                                       Opacity="0.84"
                                       Margin="0,0,0,4" />
                            <Grid Margin="0,0,0,10">
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="8" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="6" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" />
                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <TextBox x:Name="GamePathBox"
                                         Grid.Column="0"
                                         Padding="8,6"
                                         TextChanged="GamePathBox_OnTextChanged"
                                         AutomationProperties.Name="Game Program File Path" />
                                <Button x:Name="BrowseGameButton"
                                        Grid.Column="2"
                                        Content="Browse..."
                                        Padding="12,6"
                                        Click="BrowseGameButton_OnClick"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Browse for Game Program" />
                                <Button x:Name="OpenGameFolderButton"
                                        Grid.Column="4"
                                        Content="📂 Folder"
                                        Padding="10,6"
                                        Click="OpenGameFolderButton_OnClick"
                                        ToolTip="Open the game's folder in File Explorer"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Open Game Folder" />
                            </Grid>

                            <Grid>
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="12" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="0">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Optional Game Launch Options (for example: -windowed -novid):"
                                               FontSize="12"
                                               Opacity="0.84"
                                               Margin="0,0,0,4" />
                                    <TextBox x:Name="GameSwitchBox"
                                             Padding="8,6"
                                             TextChanged="EditorTextBox_OnTextChanged"
                                             AutomationProperties.Name="Optional Game Launch Options" />
                                </StackPanel>
                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="2">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Optional Starting Folder Override (leave blank for automatic):"
                                               FontSize="12"
                                               Opacity="0.84"
                                               Margin="0,0,0,4" />
                                    <TextBox x:Name="GameWorkingDirBox"
                                             Padding="8,6"
                                             TextChanged="EditorTextBox_OnTextChanged"
                                             AutomationProperties.Name="Optional Game Starting Folder" />
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Grid>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </Border>

                    <!-- 4. COMPANION TRAINER CARD + TRAINER FILE VERIFICATION -->
                    <Border x:Name="TrainerSectionBorder"
                            Padding="16,14"
                            Margin="0,0,0,12"
                            CornerRadius="8"
                            BorderThickness="1"
                            AllowDrop="True"
                            Drop="TrainerSectionBorder_OnDrop"
                            DragOver="Window_OnDragOver"
                            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                            Background="{DynamicResource CardBackgroundFillColorDefaultBrush}">
                        <StackPanel>
                            <DockPanel LastChildFill="False" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Left"
                                           Text="3. Companion Trainer Program (drag and drop your trainer file here)"
                                           FontSize="15"
                                           FontWeight="Bold"
                                           VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TrainerStatusText"
                                           DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                           Text=""
                                           FontSize="12"
                                           FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                           VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                            </DockPanel>

                            <TextBlock Text="Trainer Program File:"
                                       FontSize="12"
                                       Opacity="0.84"
                                       Margin="0,0,0,4" />
                            <Grid Margin="0,0,0,10">
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="8" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="6" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" />
                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <TextBox x:Name="TrainerPathBox"
                                         Grid.Column="0"
                                         Padding="8,6"
                                         TextChanged="TrainerPathBox_OnTextChanged"
                                         AutomationProperties.Name="Trainer Program File Path" />
                                <Button x:Name="BrowseTrainerButton"
                                        Grid.Column="2"
                                        Content="Browse..."
                                        Padding="12,6"
                                        Click="BrowseTrainerButton_OnClick"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Browse for Trainer Program" />
                                <Button x:Name="OpenTrainerFolderButton"
                                        Grid.Column="4"
                                        Content="📂 Folder"
                                        Padding="10,6"
                                        Click="OpenTrainerFolderButton_OnClick"
                                        ToolTip="Open the trainer's folder in File Explorer"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Open Trainer Folder" />
                            </Grid>

                            <Grid Margin="0,0,0,10">
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="12" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="0">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Optional Trainer Launch Options:"
                                               FontSize="12"
                                               Opacity="0.84"
                                               Margin="0,0,0,4" />
                                    <TextBox x:Name="TrainerSwitchBox"
                                             Padding="8,6"
                                             TextChanged="EditorTextBox_OnTextChanged"
                                             AutomationProperties.Name="Optional Trainer Launch Options" />
                                </StackPanel>
                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="2">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Optional Trainer Starting Folder Override (leave blank for automatic):"
                                               FontSize="12"
                                               Opacity="0.84"
                                               Margin="0,0,0,4" />
                                    <TextBox x:Name="TrainerWorkingDirBox"
                                             Padding="8,6"
                                             TextChanged="EditorTextBox_OnTextChanged"
                                             AutomationProperties.Name="Optional Trainer Starting Folder" />
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Grid>

                            <!-- Trainer Safety Verification Row -->
                            <WrapPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <CheckBox x:Name="VerifyTrainerCheckBox"
                                          Content="Warn me before launching if this trainer file ever changes on disk"
                                          VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                          Margin="0,0,12,0"
                                          Checked="VerifyTrainerCheckBox_OnChanged"
                                          Unchecked="VerifyTrainerCheckBox_OnChanged"
                                          AutomationProperties.Name="Warn Before Launching If Trainer File Changes" />
                                <Button x:Name="PinTrainerFingerprintButton"
                                        Content="🛡 Remember Trusted Trainer File"

Attribute VB_Name = "TStoreMod"
Option Explicit

' ==============================================================================
' FILE: TStore.bas (Module Name: TStoreMod)
' PROJECT: RaggieSoft StoreTrainer v1.1 (Classic Visual Basic 6.0 Edition)
' TARGET OS: Windows 95, 98, ME, NT 4.0 SP3+, 2000 SP4, XP, Vista, 7, 8.1, 10, 11
' LICENSE: MIT License (Code) / CC BY-SA 4.0 (Documentation)
'
' PLAIN-ENGLISH OVERVIEW (FOR A 100-LEVEL BEGINNER):
'   What is this file?
'     In Visual Basic 6.0 (VB6), 'TStore.vbp' sets 'Startup="Sub Main"', meaning
'     Windows runs 'Sub Main()' inside this module BEFORE opening any window!
'
'   What did StoreTrainer v1.1 upgrade here compared to v1.0?
'     1. Named Win32 Mutex ('RaggieSoft_StoreTrainer_Mutex'):
'        Calls 'CreateMutexA' in 'kernel32.dll' (with zero backslash prefixes so
'        it works all the way back to Windows 95!). Both our NSIS v1.1 patcher
'        AND StoreTrainer 2.0's Inno Setup installer check this exact Mutex name
'        to detect if 'TStore.exe' is currently running during an upgrade.
'     2. Completed 'CheckCommandLine()' Parser:
'        - '/l "C:\...\Game.stf"': Loads the '.stf' profile, launches the game +
'          trainer immediately, and exits via 'ExitProcess' without flashing the
'          editor window on screen!
'        - '/e "C:\...\Game.stf"': Opens 'frmMain' pre-loaded with that '.stf'.
'        - '"C:\...\Game.stf"' (double-clicked in Windows Explorer): Launches!
' ==============================================================================

' Enables Windows XP+ themed Common Controls when paired with TStore.exe.manifest
Public Declare Function InitCommonControls Lib "comctl32.dll" () As Long

' Cleanly terminates the Win32 process with an integer exit code (preferable to VB6 'End')
Public Declare Sub ExitProcess Lib "kernel32" (ByVal uExitCode As Long)

' Creates a named kernel Mutex object across Windows 95 through Windows 11
Public Declare Function CreateMutexA Lib "kernel32" ( _
    ByVal lpMutexAttributes As Long, _
    ByVal bInitialOwner As Long, _
    ByVal lpName As String) As Long

' Closes a Win32 kernel handle cleanly when shutting down
Public Declare Function CloseHandle Lib "kernel32" (ByVal hObject As Long) As Long

' Module-level handle keeping 'RaggieSoft_StoreTrainer_Mutex' alive while TStore.exe runs
Private g_hAppMutex As Long

' Shared path populated when '/e "file.stf"' is passed on the command line
Public g_strPendingEditFile As String

Sub Main()
    ' Step 1: Register our named Win32 Mutex so NSIS & Inno Setup installers know we are open
    g_hAppMutex = CreateMutexA(0&, 0&, "RaggieSoft_StoreTrainer_Mutex")

    ' Step 2: Turn on Windows XP+ Visual Styles before any form/dialog loads
    InitCommonControls

    ' Step 3: Ensure %APPDATA%\RaggieSoft\StoreTrainer\TStore.ini exists
    If GetStoreTrainerDataFile = "" Then
        CreateStoreTrainerData
    End If

    ' Step 4: Inspect Command$ for '/l', '/e', or a double-clicked '.stf' StoreFile!
    Dim intCmdReturn As Integer
    intCmdReturn = CheckCommandLine(Command$)

    ' Return code 2 means '/l' (or Explorer double-click) already launched the StoreFile:
    ' close our Mutex handle and exit cleanly without opening frmMain!
    If intCmdReturn = 2 Then
        ReleaseAppMutex
        ExitProcess 0
    ElseIf intCmdReturn < 0 Then
        ' Negative return indicates a command-line launch error already reported to the user
        ReleaseAppMutex
        ExitProcess Abs(intCmdReturn)
    End If

    ' Step 5: Refresh stored App.Path inside TStore.ini if TStore.exe moved folders
    Dim strCurPath As String
    strCurPath = IniGetValueString(GetStoreTrainerDataFile, "General", "Path", "PATH_NAME")
    If strCurPath <> App.Path Then
        IniWriteValueString GetStoreTrainerDataFile, "General", "Path", App.Path
    End If
    IniWriteValueString GetStoreTrainerDataFile, "General", "Version", App.Major & "." & App.Minor & "." & App.Revision

    ' Step 6: Ensure 'My Documents\My StoreFiles' exists
    Dim strSTFFolder As String
    strSTFFolder = GetStoreFileFolder(True, True)
    If (strSTFFolder = "NO_FOLDER_CREATED") Then
        MsgBox App.ProductName & " requires that you create a StoreFile folder. Now exiting!", vbCritical, App.ProductName
        ReleaseAppMutex
        ExitProcess 1
    End If

    ' Step 7: Show the main StoreFile Editor window (and load g_strPendingEditFile if '/e' was used)
    frmMain.Show
    If g_strPendingEditFile <> "" Then
        frmMain.LoadStoreFileIntoForm g_strPendingEditFile
    End If
End Sub

' Releases the Win32 Mutex handle before process exit
Public Sub ReleaseAppMutex()
    If g_hAppMutex <> 0& Then
        CloseHandle g_hAppMutex
        g_hAppMutex = 0&
    End If
End Sub

' ==============================================================================
' CheckCommandLine:
'   Parses VB6's raw Command$ string.
'   Returns:
'      0 = No command-line switch; open normal blank editor
'      1 = '/e <file.stf>' -> open editor with <file.stf> loaded
'      2 = '/l <file.stf>' (or bare '<file.stf>') -> launched immediately!
'     <0 = Error code (file missing or launch failed)
' ==============================================================================
Public Function CheckCommandLine(Optional ByVal CommandLine As String = "") As Integer
    Dim strTrimmed As String
    Dim strSwitch As String
    Dim strTargetFile As String
    Dim iOpenRet As Integer
    Dim iLaunchRet As Integer

    g_strPendingEditFile = ""
    strTrimmed = Trim$(CommandLine)
    If strTrimmed = "" Then
        CheckCommandLine = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' Check if the command line starts with '/l', '-l', '/e', or '-e'
    If Len(strTrimmed) >= 3 And (Left$(strTrimmed, 1) = "/" Or Left$(strTrimmed, 1) = "-") Then
        strSwitch = LCase$(Left$(strTrimmed, 2))
        strTargetFile = StripSurroundingQuotes(Trim$(Mid$(strTrimmed, 3)))
    Else
        ' Bare file path (e.g., double-clicking 'Doom.stf' in Windows Explorer) -> treat as '/l'
        strSwitch = "/l"
        strTargetFile = StripSurroundingQuotes(strTrimmed)
    End If

    If strTargetFile = "" Then
        CheckCommandLine = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' Edit Mode ('/e' or '-e')
    If strSwitch = "/e" Or strSwitch = "-e" Then
        g_strPendingEditFile = strTargetFile
        CheckCommandLine = 1
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' Launch Mode ('/l' or '-l')
    If strSwitch = "/l" Or strSwitch = "-l" Then
        SetLaunchingSTF True
        iOpenRet = OpenStoreFile(strTargetFile)
        If iOpenRet <> 0 Then
            MsgBox "Unable to open StoreFile (" & strTargetFile & "). Error code: " & iOpenRet, vbExclamation, App.ProductName
            CheckCommandLine = -2
            Exit Function
        End If

        SetFileName strTargetFile
        isSilentDirtyReset
        AddRecentStoreFile strTargetFile

        iLaunchRet = Launch()
        If iLaunchRet <> 0 Then
            MsgBox "StoreTrainer could not launch the game or trainer (Code " & iLaunchRet & "). Please edit the StoreFile to check its file paths.", vbExclamation, App.ProductName
            CheckCommandLine = -3
            Exit Function
        End If

        CheckCommandLine = 2
        Exit Function
    End If

    CheckCommandLine = 0
End Function

' Helper stripping outer double-quotes from a Windows command-line path argument
Private Function StripSurroundingQuotes(ByVal sValue As String) As String
    Dim sWork As String
    sWork = Trim$(sValue)
    If Len(sWork) >= 2 Then
        If Left$(sWork, 1) = Chr$(34) And Right$(sWork, 1) = Chr$(34) Then
            sWork = Mid$(sWork, 2, Len(sWork) - 2)
        End If
    End If
    StripSurroundingQuotes = sWork
End Function

title: vb6-v1.1/SFile.bas (StoreTrainer 1.1 — Parent Folder Working Dir, Launch Delay & Recent Files)
description: Fixes parent-folder working directory resolution and multi-flag launch switches while adding 0–30s launch delays and Recent StoreFiles.
code:
Attribute VB_Name = "SFile"
Option Explicit

' ==============================================================================
' FILE: SFile.bas
' PROJECT: RaggieSoft StoreTrainer v1.1 (Classic Visual Basic 6.0 Edition)
' LICENSE: MIT License (Code) / CC BY-SA 4.0 (Documentation)
'
' PLAIN-ENGLISH OVERVIEW (FOR A 100-LEVEL BEGINNER):
'   What is this file?
'     'SFile.bas' manages reading, writing, and launching '.stf' StoreFiles!
'     Each '.stf' file is a human-readable Windows INI file storing the path
'     and command-line switches for a PC game and its companion trainer.
'
'   Key Bug Fixes & Features Added in StoreTrainer v1.1:
'     1. Backward-Compatible Version Check ('OpenStoreFile'):
'        v1.0 rejected any '.stf' file whose version was less than the current
'        version ('iSTFCompare = -1'). v1.1 accepts BOTH '1.0' and '1.1' '.stf'
'        files seamlessly (and also interoperates with StoreTrainer 2.0!).
'     2. Working Directory Fix ('ChDir FSO.GetParentFolderName(...)'):
'        In v1.0, 'ChDir GetGamePath()' passed a '.exe' file path instead of its
'        parent folder, raising VB6 Run-time error 76 ('Path not found'). v1.1
'        extracts 'FSO.GetParentFolderName(...)' first so classic games find
'        their data WADs/PK3s/DLLs reliably.
'     3. Multi-Flag Command-Line Switch Fix:
'        In v1.0, switches were wrapped inside extra Chr$(34) quotes, turning
'        '-windowed -novid' into a single literal argument. v1.1 appends switches
'        cleanly without outer quotes.
'     4. Configurable Launch Delay ('LaunchDelaySeconds', 0–30s) & Recent Files MRU:
'        Adds '[General] LaunchDelay' using Win32 'Sleep' in 100ms slices with
'        'DoEvents' so Windows 95/98/2000 stays responsive, plus '[Recent] File1..4'.
' ==============================================================================

' Win32 Sleep API (pauses execution in milliseconds without 100% CPU busy-waiting)
Private Declare Sub Sleep Lib "kernel32" (ByVal dwMilliseconds As Long)

' In-memory state of the currently loaded StoreFile
Private isFileDirty As Boolean
Private strFileName As String
Private TrainerLaunchesGame As Boolean
Private LaunchGameFirst As Boolean
Private LaunchDelaySeconds As Long
Private GamePath As String, GameSwitch As String
Private TrainerPath As String, TrainerSwitch As String
Private doLaunch As Boolean ' Fast-exit flag during '/l' silent StoreFile launches

Public Function GetLaunchingSTF() As Boolean
    GetLaunchingSTF = doLaunch
End Function

Public Sub SetLaunchingSTF(boolDoLaunch As Boolean)
    doLaunch = boolDoLaunch
End Sub

' Clears dirty flag without touching frmMain (used by Sub Main during '/l' silent launch)
Public Sub isSilentDirtyReset()
    isFileDirty = False
End Sub

' Returns the current '.stf' schema version ('1.1' — 100% compatible with v1.0 & v2.0)
Public Function GetSTFVersionStr() As String
    GetSTFVersionStr = "1.1"
End Function

' Resets memory state for File -> New
Public Sub NewStoreFile()
    SetLaunchGameFirst False
    SetTrainerLaunchesGame False
    SetLaunchDelaySeconds 0
    SetGamePath ""
    SetGameSwitch ""
    SetTrainerPath ""
    SetTrainerSwitch ""
    SetFileName "untitled"
End Sub

Public Function GetLaunchGameFirst() As Boolean
    GetLaunchGameFirst = LaunchGameFirst
End Function

Public Sub SetLaunchGameFirst(boolLaunchGameFirst As Boolean)
    LaunchGameFirst = boolLaunchGameFirst
End Sub

Public Sub SetTrainerLaunchesGame(boolLaunchType As Boolean)
    TrainerLaunchesGame = boolLaunchType
    If boolLaunchType = True Then
        LaunchGameFirst = False
    End If
End Sub

Public Function GetTrainerLaunchesGame() As Boolean
    GetTrainerLaunchesGame = TrainerLaunchesGame
End Function

Public Function GetLaunchDelaySeconds() As Long
    GetLaunchDelaySeconds = LaunchDelaySeconds
End Function

Public Sub SetLaunchDelaySeconds(ByVal lngSeconds As Long)
    If lngSeconds < 0 Then lngSeconds = 0
    If lngSeconds > 30 Then lngSeconds = 30
    LaunchDelaySeconds = lngSeconds
End Sub

Public Function GetGamePath() As String
    GetGamePath = GamePath
End Function

Public Sub SetGamePath(strGamePath As String)
    GamePath = strGamePath
End Sub

Public Function GetTrainerPath() As String
    GetTrainerPath = TrainerPath
End Function

Public Sub SetTrainerPath(strTrainerPath As String)
    TrainerPath = strTrainerPath
End Sub

Public Function GetGameSwitch() As String
    GetGameSwitch = GameSwitch
End Function

Public Sub SetGameSwitch(strGameSwitch As String)
    GameSwitch = strGameSwitch
End Sub

Public Function GetTrainerSwitch() As String
    GetTrainerSwitch = TrainerSwitch
End Function

Public Sub SetTrainerSwitch(strTrainerSwitch As String)
    TrainerSwitch = strTrainerSwitch
End Sub

' Updates window title bar ('*' indicates unsaved edits)
Public Sub SetFileFlag(dirtyFlag As Boolean, frmName As Form)
    On Error GoTo ErrorTrap
    If dirtyFlag = True Then
        isFileDirty = True
        frmName.Caption = GetFileName(True) & " * - " & App.ProductName
    Else
        isFileDirty = False
        frmName.Caption = GetFileName(True) & " - " & App.ProductName
    End If
    Exit Sub
ErrorTrap:
    MsgBox Err.Number & ": " & Err.Description, vbExclamation, App.ProductName
End Sub

Public Function GetFileFlag() As Boolean
    GetFileFlag = isFileDirty
End Function

' Writes the current StoreFile to disk in backward-compatible INI format
Public Function SaveStoreFile(frmName As Form, strTargetFile As String) As Integer
    On Error GoTo ErrorTrapper

    IniWriteValueString strTargetFile, "General", "STF.Version", GetSTFVersionStr
    IniWriteValueString strTargetFile, "General", "LaunchDelay", CStr(GetLaunchDelaySeconds())

    Dim strTrainerLaunchesGame As String
    strTrainerLaunchesGame = IIf(GetTrainerLaunchesGame(), "true", "false")
    IniWriteValueString strTargetFile, "Trainer", "TrainerLaunchesGame", strTrainerLaunchesGame

    Dim strLaunchGameFirst As String
    strLaunchGameFirst = IIf(GetLaunchGameFirst() And Not GetTrainerLaunchesGame(), "true", "false")
    IniWriteValueString strTargetFile, "Game", "LaunchGameFirst", strLaunchGameFirst

    IniWriteValueString strTargetFile, "Game", "Path", GetGamePath
    IniWriteValueString strTargetFile, "Game", "Switch", GetGameSwitch

    IniWriteValueString strTargetFile, "Trainer", "Path", GetTrainerPath
    IniWriteValueString strTargetFile, "Trainer", "Switch", GetTrainerSwitch

    AddRecentStoreFile strTargetFile
    SetFileFlag False, frmName
    SaveStoreFile = 0
    Exit Function

ErrorTrapper:
    SaveStoreFile = Err.Number
End Function

' Opens a '.stf' StoreFile into memory (supports both v1.0 and v1.1 '.stf' files!)
Public Function OpenStoreFile(strFilePath As String) As Integer
    Dim FSO As FileSystemObject
    Set FSO = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")

    If Not FSO.FileExists(strFilePath) Then
        OpenStoreFile = 53 ' VB6 File Not Found
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim strSTFVersion As String
    strSTFVersion = IniGetValueString(strFilePath, "General", "STF.Version", "1.0")

    ' Reject ONLY if the file requires a major version newer than '1.1' (e.g., '3.0').
    ' Older '1.0' files (iSTFCompare = -1) load with 100% backward compatibility!
    Dim iSTFCompare As Integer
    iSTFCompare = CheckVersion(strSTFVersion, GetSTFVersionStr)
    If iSTFCompare = 1 Then
        OpenStoreFile = 1
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim strTrainerLaunchesGame As String
    strTrainerLaunchesGame = LCase$(IniGetValueString(strFilePath, "Trainer", "TrainerLaunchesGame", "false"))
    SetTrainerLaunchesGame (strTrainerLaunchesGame = "true" Or strTrainerLaunchesGame = "1")

    Dim strLaunchGameFirst As String
    strLaunchGameFirst = LCase$(IniGetValueString(strFilePath, "Game", "LaunchGameFirst", "false"))
    If GetTrainerLaunchesGame() Then
        SetLaunchGameFirst False
    Else
        SetLaunchGameFirst (strLaunchGameFirst = "true" Or strLaunchGameFirst = "1")
    End If

    SetLaunchDelaySeconds CLng(Val(IniGetValueString(strFilePath, "General", "LaunchDelay", "0")))

    SetGamePath IniGetValueString(strFilePath, "Game", "Path", vbNullString)
    SetGameSwitch IniGetValueString(strFilePath, "Game", "Switch", vbNullString)

    SetTrainerPath IniGetValueString(strFilePath, "Trainer", "Path", vbNullString)
    SetTrainerSwitch IniGetValueString(strFilePath, "Trainer", "Switch", vbNullString)

    OpenStoreFile = 0
End Function

Public Sub SetFileName(strLocalFileName As String)
    strFileName = strLocalFileName
End Sub

Public Function GetFileName(Optional showFileNameOnly As Boolean) As String
    On Error GoTo cantReadRegistry
    Dim strLocalFileName As String
    strLocalFileName = strFileName
    Dim boolHideExtensions As Boolean

    If showFileNameOnly = True Then
        Dim FSO As FileSystemObject
        Set FSO = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
        boolHideExtensions = CBool(Val(RegGetValue$(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced", "HideFileExt")))
        If boolHideExtensions Then
            strLocalFileName = FSO.GetBaseName(strLocalFileName)
        Else
            strLocalFileName = FSO.GetFileName(strLocalFileName)
        End If
        GetFileName = strLocalFileName
        Exit Function
    End If

    GetFileName = strFileName
    Exit Function
cantReadRegistry:
    boolHideExtensions = False
    Resume Next
End Function

' ==============================================================================
' RECENT FILES (MRU) HELPERS — Stored in %APPDATA%\RaggieSoft\StoreTrainer\TStore.ini
' ==============================================================================
Public Sub AddRecentStoreFile(ByVal sPath As String)
    Dim sIni As String
    Dim arrExisting(1 To 4) As String
    Dim arrUpdated(1 To 4) As String
    Dim i As Integer, outIdx As Integer

    sIni = GetStoreTrainerDataFile()
    If sIni = "" Or Trim$(sPath) = "" Or LCase$(Trim$(sPath)) = "untitled" Then Exit Sub

    For i = 1 To 4
        arrExisting(i) = IniGetValueString(sIni, "Recent", "File" & CStr(i), "")
    Next i

    arrUpdated(1) = sPath
    outIdx = 2
    For i = 1 To 4
        If outIdx <= 4 Then
            If arrExisting(i) <> "" And LCase$(arrExisting(i)) <> LCase$(sPath) Then
                arrUpdated(outIdx) = arrExisting(i)
                outIdx = outIdx + 1
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    For i = 1 To 4
        IniWriteValueString sIni, "Recent", "File" & CStr(i), arrUpdated(i)
    Next i
End Sub

Public Function GetRecentStoreFile(ByVal indexOneToFour As Integer) As String
    Dim sIni As String
    sIni = GetStoreTrainerDataFile()
    If sIni = "" Or indexOneToFour < 1 Or indexOneToFour > 4 Then
        GetRecentStoreFile = ""
        Exit Function
    End If
    GetRecentStoreFile = IniGetValueString(sIni, "Recent", "File" & CStr(indexOneToFour), "")
End Function

' Pauses between launching the first and second program while pumping Win32 events
Private Sub ResponsiveDelaySeconds(ByVal lngSeconds As Long)
    Dim totalLoops As Long, k As Long
    If lngSeconds <= 0 Then Exit Sub
    totalLoops = lngSeconds * 10
    For k = 1 To totalLoops
        Sleep 100
        DoEvents
    Next k
End Sub

' Safely changes drive + working directory to the parent folder of an executable
Private Sub SetWorkingFolderForExe(ByVal sExePath As String, ByRef FSO As FileSystemObject)
    On Error Resume Next
    Dim sParent As String
    sParent = FSO.GetParentFolderName(sExePath)
    If sParent <> "" Then
        ChDrive sParent
        ChDir sParent
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' Launches the configured Game and Trainer programs
Public Function Launch() As Integer
    On Error GoTo LaunchError
    Dim FSO As FileSystemObject
    Set FSO = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")

    ' 1. File must be saved first
    If GetFileFlag = True Or LCase$(GetFileName) = "untitled" Then
        Launch = 1
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' 2. Verify Trainer executable exists
    If DoesFileExist(GetTrainerPath) = False Then
        Launch = 2
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' 3. Verify Game executable exists (unless the Trainer itself launches the Game)
    If GetTrainerLaunchesGame = False Then
        If DoesFileExist(GetGamePath) = False Then
            Launch = 3
            Exit Function
        End If
    End If

    ' 4. Build command lines: quote the executable path ONLY, and append switches unquoted
    '    so multi-flag switches like '-windowed -novid' parse as separate arguments!
    Dim strGameAndSwitch As String, strTrainerAndSwitch As String
    strGameAndSwitch = Chr$(34) & GetGamePath & Chr$(34)
    If Trim$(GetGameSwitch) <> "" Then
        strGameAndSwitch = strGameAndSwitch & " " & Trim$(GetGameSwitch)
    End If

    strTrainerAndSwitch = Chr$(34) & GetTrainerPath & Chr$(34)
    If Trim$(GetTrainerSwitch) <> "" Then
        strTrainerAndSwitch = strTrainerAndSwitch & " " & Trim$(GetTrainerSwitch)
    End If

    ' Mode A: Trainer launches the game automatically -> launch Trainer only
    If GetTrainerLaunchesGame = True Then
        SetWorkingFolderForExe GetTrainerPath(), FSO
        Shell strTrainerAndSwitch, vbNormalFocus
        Launch = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' Mode B: Launch Game First -> optional delay -> launch Trainer
    If GetLaunchGameFirst = True Then
        SetWorkingFolderForExe GetGamePath(), FSO
        Shell strGameAndSwitch, vbNormalFocus
        DoEvents
        ResponsiveDelaySeconds GetLaunchDelaySeconds()
        SetWorkingFolderForExe GetTrainerPath(), FSO
        Shell strTrainerAndSwitch, vbNormalFocus
        DoEvents
        Launch = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' Mode C: Launch Trainer first -> optional delay -> launch Game
    SetWorkingFolderForExe GetTrainerPath(), FSO
    Shell strTrainerAndSwitch, vbNormalFocus
    DoEvents
    ResponsiveDelaySeconds GetLaunchDelaySeconds()
    SetWorkingFolderForExe GetGamePath(), FSO
    Shell strGameAndSwitch, vbNormalFocus
    DoEvents
    Launch = 0
    Exit Function

LaunchError:
    Launch = 4
End Function

Private m_bPopulatingForm As Boolean

Private Sub Form_Load()
    SetFileName "untitled"
    SetFileFlag False, Me
    RefreshRecentFilesMenu
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Unload(Cancel As Integer)
    ReleaseAppMutex
End Sub

Private Sub Form_QueryUnload(Cancel As Integer, UnloadMode As Integer)
    Dim iMSG As VbMsgBoxResult

    If GetLaunchingSTF = True Then
        Cancel = False
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If GetFileFlag() = False Then
        iMSG = MsgBox("Are you sure you want to exit " & App.Title & "?", vbQuestion + vbYesNo, App.ProductName)
        Cancel = (iMSG = vbNo)
    Else
        iMSG = MsgBox("Would you like to save your work before exiting?", vbQuestion + vbYesNoCancel, App.ProductName)
        If iMSG = vbYes Then
            If LCase$(GetFileName()) = "untitled" Then
                Dim strSaveFile As String
                strSaveFile = DisplaySaveAs()
                If strSaveFile = "32755" Then
                    Cancel = True
                    Exit Sub
                End If
                SetFileName strSaveFile
            End If
            SaveStoreFile Me, GetFileName()
            Cancel = False
        ElseIf iMSG = vbNo Then
            Cancel = False
        Else
            Cancel = True
        End If
    End If
End Sub

' Public helper called by File -> Open, File -> Recent, and Sub Main ('/e' switch)
Public Sub LoadStoreFileIntoForm(ByVal strPath As String)
    Dim iRet As Integer
    iRet = OpenStoreFile(strPath)
    If iRet = 53 Then
        MsgBox "The StoreFile could not be found:" & vbCrLf & strPath, vbExclamation, App.ProductName
        Exit Sub
    ElseIf iRet = 1 Then
        MsgBox "This StoreFile requires a newer version of " & App.ProductName & ".", vbExclamation, App.ProductName
        Exit Sub
    ElseIf iRet <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "Unable to open StoreFile (Code " & iRet & ").", vbExclamation, App.ProductName
        Exit Sub
    End If

    m_bPopulatingForm = True
    Me.chkTrainerLaunchesGame.Value = IIf(GetTrainerLaunchesGame(), vbChecked, vbUnchecked)
    Me.chkLaunchGameFirst.Value = IIf(GetLaunchGameFirst() And Not GetTrainerLaunchesGame(), vbChecked, vbUnchecked)
    Me.txtLaunchDelay.Text = CStr(GetLaunchDelaySeconds())
    Me.txtGamePath.Text = GetGamePath()
    Me.txtGameSwitch.Text = GetGameSwitch()
    Me.txtTrainerPath.Text = GetTrainerPath()
    Me.txtTrainerSwitch.Text = GetTrainerSwitch()
    ApplyTrainerLaunchesGameUIState
    m_bPopulatingForm = False

    SetFileName strPath
    AddRecentStoreFile strPath
    RefreshRecentFilesMenu
    SetFileFlag False, Me
End Sub

Public Sub RefreshRecentFilesMenu()
    Dim s1 As String, s2 As String, s3 As String, s4 As String
    s1 = GetRecentStoreFile(1)
    s2 = GetRecentStoreFile(2)
    s3 = GetRecentStoreFile(3)
    s4 = GetRecentStoreFile(4)

    If s1 = "" Then
        mnuFileRecent1.Caption = "(No Recent StoreFiles)"
        mnuFileRecent1.Enabled = False
        mnuFileRecent1.Tag = ""
    Else
        mnuFileRecent1.Caption = "&1 " & s1
        mnuFileRecent1.Enabled = True
        mnuFileRecent1.Tag = s1
    End If

    SetupOptionalRecentMenu mnuFileRecent2, 2, s2
    SetupOptionalRecentMenu mnuFileRecent3, 3, s3
    SetupOptionalRecentMenu mnuFileRecent4, 4, s4
End Sub

Private Sub SetupOptionalRecentMenu(mnuItem As Menu, ByVal idx As Integer, ByVal sPath As String)
    If sPath = "" Then
        mnuItem.Visible = False
        mnuItem.Tag = ""
    Else
        mnuItem.Caption = "&" & CStr(idx) & " " & sPath
        mnuItem.Tag = sPath
        mnuItem.Visible = True
    End If
End Sub

    If GetFileFlag() = True Then
        Dim iMSG As VbMsgBoxResult
        iMSG = MsgBox("Save changes to " & GetFileName(True) & " before opening another StoreFile?", vbYesNoCancel + vbQuestion, App.ProductName)
        If iMSG = vbCancel Then Exit Sub
        If iMSG = vbYes Then mnuFileSave_Click

    LoadStoreFileIntoForm sPath
End Sub

End Sub

    Dim bTrainerStartsGame As Boolean
    bTrainerStartsGame = (chkTrainerLaunchesGame.Value = vbChecked)
    SetTrainerLaunchesGame bTrainerStartsGame

    If bTrainerStartsGame Then
        Me.chkLaunchGameFirst.Value = vbUnchecked
        Me.chkLaunchGameFirst.Enabled = False
        Me.txtLaunchDelay.Enabled = False
        Me.lblLaunchDelay.Enabled = False
        Me.txtGamePath.Enabled = False
        Me.txtGameSwitch.Enabled = False
        Me.cmdBrowseGame.Enabled = False
        Me.mnuProjectBrowseGame.Enabled = False
        Me.mnuProjrectSwitchGame.Enabled = False
        Me.picXPShim2.Enabled = False
        Me.fraGameData.Enabled = False
        Me.lblGameSwitch.Enabled = False
        Me.txtGamePath.BackColor = vbButtonFace
        Me.txtGameSwitch.BackColor = vbButtonFace
        Me.txtLaunchDelay.BackColor = vbButtonFace
    Else
        Me.chkLaunchGameFirst.Enabled = True
        Me.txtLaunchDelay.Enabled = True
        Me.lblLaunchDelay.Enabled = True
        Me.txtGamePath.Enabled = True
        Me.txtGameSwitch.Enabled = True
        Me.cmdBrowseGame.Enabled = True
        Me.mnuProjectBrowseGame.Enabled = True
        Me.mnuProjrectSwitchGame.Enabled = True
        Me.picXPShim2.Enabled = True
        Me.fraGameData.Enabled = True
        Me.lblGameSwitch.Enabled = True
        Me.txtGamePath.BackColor = vbWindowBackground
        Me.txtGameSwitch.BackColor = vbWindowBackground
        Me.txtLaunchDelay.BackColor = vbWindowBackground
    End If
End Sub

    If m_bPopulatingForm Then Exit Sub
    ApplyTrainerLaunchesGameUIState
    SetFileFlag True, Me
End Sub

    If m_bPopulatingForm Then Exit Sub
    SetLaunchDelaySeconds CLng(Val(txtLaunchDelay.Text))
    SetFileFlag True, Me

Private Sub cmdBrowseGame_Click()
    On Error GoTo Trap
    With Me.cdgStoreFile
        .CancelError = True
        .Filter = "Executable Files (*.exe)|*.exe|All Files (*.*)|*.*"
        .DefaultExt = "exe"
        .DialogTitle = "Locate Game"
        .Flags = cdlOFNFileMustExist
        .InitDir = Environ("ProgramFiles")
        .ShowOpen
        Me.txtGamePath.Text = .FileName
        SetGamePath .FileName
    End With
    validateFile txtGamePath
    SetFileFlag True, Me
    Exit Sub
Trap:
    Exit Sub
End Sub

Private Sub cmdBrowseTrainer_Click()
    On Error GoTo Trap
    With Me.cdgStoreFile
        .CancelError = True
        .InitDir = FGetSpecialFolder(CSIDL_DOCUMENTS)
        .Filter = "Executable Files (*.exe)|*.exe|All Files (*.*)|*.*"
        .DefaultExt = "exe"
        .DialogTitle = "Locate Trainer"
        .Flags = cdlOFNFileMustExist
        .ShowOpen
        Me.txtTrainerPath.Text = .FileName
        SetTrainerPath .FileName
    End With
    validateFile txtTrainerPath
    SetFileFlag True, Me
    Exit Sub
Trap:
    Exit Sub
End Sub

Private Sub cmdLaunch_Click()
    doLaunch
End Sub

Private Function DisplaySaveAs() As String
    On Error GoTo Trapper
    With Me.cdgStoreFile
        .CancelError = True
        .DialogTitle = "Save StoreFile"
        .Filter = "StoreFile (*.stf)|*.stf"
        .InitDir = GetStoreFileFolder()
        .DefaultExt = "stf"
        .ShowSave
        DisplaySaveAs = .FileName
    End With
    Exit Function
Trapper:
    If Err.Number = 32755 Then
        DisplaySaveAs = "32755"
    End If
End Function

End Sub

    createNewStoreFile

    On Error GoTo Trapper
    With Me.cdgStoreFile
        .CancelError = True
        .DialogTitle = "Open StoreFile"
        .DefaultExt = "stf"
        .Filter = "StoreTrainer File (*.stf)|*.stf"
        .InitDir = GetStoreFileFolder()
        .Flags = cdlOFNFileMustExist
        .ShowOpen
        LoadStoreFileIntoForm .FileName
    End With
    Exit Sub
Trapper:
    Exit Sub
End Sub

Private Sub mnuFileSave_Click()
    Dim strCurFile As String
    strCurFile = GetFileName()
    If LCase$(strCurFile) = "untitled" Then
        mnuFileSaveAs_Click
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim iRet As Integer
    iRet = SaveStoreFile(Me, GetFileName())
    RefreshRecentFilesMenu

    If iRet <> 0 And iRet <> 32755 Then
        MsgBox "Error saving StoreFile: " & iRet, vbExclamation, App.ProductName
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub mnuFileSaveAs_Click()
    Dim strFile As String
    strFile = DisplaySaveAs()
    If strFile = "32755" Or strFile = "" Then
        Exit Sub
    End If

    SetFileName strFile
    SaveStoreFile Me, strFile
    RefreshRecentFilesMenu
End Sub

    AboutStoreTrainer

    Dim strTrainerSwitch As String
    strTrainerSwitch = InputBox$("Please enter a trainer switch", "Input Trainer Switch", GetTrainerSwitch())
    If strTrainerSwitch <> "" Then
        txtTrainerSwitch.Text = strTrainerSwitch
        SetTrainerSwitch strTrainerSwitch
        SetFileFlag True, Me
    End If
Done:
End Sub

Private Sub mnuProjrectSwitchGame_Click()
    On Error GoTo Done
    Dim strGameSwitch As String
    strGameSwitch = InputBox$("Please enter a game switch", "Input Game Switch", GetGameSwitch())
    If strGameSwitch <> "" Then
        txtGameSwitch.Text = strGameSwitch
        SetGameSwitch strGameSwitch
        SetFileFlag True, Me
    End If

    If m_bPopulatingForm Then Exit Sub
    SetGamePath txtGamePath.Text
    SetFileFlag True, Me

End Sub

    If m_bPopulatingForm Then Exit Sub
    SetGameSwitch txtGameSwitch.Text
    SetFileFlag True, Me
End Sub

Private Sub txtTrainerPath_Change()
    If m_bPopulatingForm Then Exit Sub
    SetTrainerPath txtTrainerPath.Text
    SetFileFlag True, Me
End Sub

Private Sub txtTrainerPath_LostFocus()
    validateFile txtTrainerPath
End Sub

    If m_bPopulatingForm Then Exit Sub
    SetTrainerSwitch txtTrainerSwitch.Text
    SetFileFlag True, Me
End Sub

Private Sub validateFile(txt As TextBox)
    If Trim$(txt.Text) = "" Then
        txt.BackColor = vbWindowBackground
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If DoesFileExist(txt.Text) = False Then
        txt.BackColor = vbRed
        MsgBox "The file " & Chr$(34) & txt.Text & Chr$(34) & " does not exist!", vbExclamation, App.Title
    Else
        txt.BackColor = vbWindowBackground
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub createNewStoreFile()
    Dim iMSG As VbMsgBoxResult
    If GetFileFlag = True Then
        iMSG = MsgBox("Would you like to save your work before creating a new StoreFile?", vbYesNoCancel + vbQuestion, App.Title)
        If iMSG = vbCancel Then Exit Sub
        If iMSG = vbYes Then mnuFileSave_Click
    Else
        iMSG = MsgBox("Close " & GetFileName(True) & " and create a new StoreFile?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion, App.Title)
        If iMSG = vbNo Then Exit Sub
    End If

    m_bPopulatingForm = True
    NewStoreFile
    Me.chkTrainerLaunchesGame.Value = vbUnchecked
    Me.chkLaunchGameFirst.Value = vbUnchecked
    Me.txtLaunchDelay.Text = "0"
    Me.txtGamePath.Text = ""
    Me.txtGameSwitch.Text = ""
    Me.txtTrainerPath.Text = ""
    Me.txtTrainerSwitch.Text = ""
    ApplyTrainerLaunchesGameUIState
    m_bPopulatingForm = False
    SetFileFlag False, Me
End Sub

Private Sub doLaunch()
    Dim iLaunch As Integer
    iLaunch = Launch()
    If iLaunch <> 0 Then
        Select Case iLaunch
            Case 1
                MsgBox "Please save your StoreFile before launching!", vbExclamation, App.Title
            Case 2
                MsgBox "The trainer file path does not exist!", vbExclamation, App.Title
            Case 3
                MsgBox "The game file path does not exist!", vbExclamation, App.Title
            Case Else
                MsgBox "Unable to start the game or trainer (Error " & iLaunch & ").", vbExclamation, App.Title
        End Select
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub Form_QueryUnload(Cancel As Integer, UnloadMode As Integer)
    Dim iMSG As VbMsgBoxResult
    
    ' When a StoreFile is launched, we must quickly close up
    If GetLaunchingSTF = True Then
        Cancel = False
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' A files is not being launched
    If GetFileFlag() = False Then
        iMSG = MsgBox("Are you sure you want to exit " & App.Title & "?", vbQuestion + vbYesNo)
        If iMSG = vbNo Then
            Cancel = True
        End If
        If iMSG = vbYes Then
            Cancel = False
        End If
    Else
        
        iMSG = MsgBox("Would you like to save your work before exiting?", vbQuestion + vbYesNoCancel, App.ProductName)
        If iMSG = vbYes Then
            ' File isn't saved yet.  Show a Save As dialog
            If LCase$(GetFileName()) = "untitled" Then
                Dim strSaveFile As String
                strSaveFile = DisplaySaveAs()
                If strSaveFile = "32755" Then
                    ' User clicked Cancel in the Save As dialog
                    Cancel = True
                    Exit Sub
                End If
                
                ' Write that filename to memory
                SetFileName (strSaveFile)
            End If
            
            ' Write data to disk
            SaveStoreFile Me, GetFileName()
            Cancel = False
        End If
        If iMSG = vbNo Then
            Cancel = False
        End If
        If iMSG = vbCancel Then
            ' Cancel.  No exit, No save.
            Cancel = True
        End If
    End If
End Sub

Attribute VB_Name = "TStoreMod"
Option Explicit



' On Windows XP or later, turns on Visual Styles
Public Declare Function InitCommonControls Lib "comctl32.dll" () As Long

'Allows us to have a return code (use in place of an End statement)
Public Declare Sub ExitProcess Lib "kernel32" (ByVal uExitCode As Long)

Sub Main()
    ' Checks the command line to see if we have a file to operate on
    ' /e filename.stf to Edit a file
    ' /l filename.stf to Launch a file
    Dim intCmdReturn As Integer
    intCmdReturn = CheckCommandLine(Command$)
    
    ' Tells StoreTrainer that we want to turn on Visual Styles in Windows XP or later
    InitCommonControls
    
    ' Let's create TStore.INI if necessary
    If GetStoreTrainerDataFile = "" Then
        CreateStoreTrainerData
    End If
    
    ' Let's refresh the StoreTrainer Path if necessary
    ' This is primarily used for refreshing when switching from DEBUG to PRODUCTION
    Dim strCurPath As String
    strCurPath = IniGetValueString(GetStoreTrainerDataFile, "General", "Path", "PATH_NAME")
    If strCurPath <> App.Path Then
        Dim iMSG As VbMsgBoxResult
        iMSG = MsgBox("The " & App.ProductName & " configuration settings need to be updated.  Do that now?", vbYesNoCancel + vbQuestion, App.ProductName)
        If iMSG = vbCancel Then ExitProcess 4 'User Canceled updating TSTORE.INI
        If iMSG = vbYes Then
            IniWriteValueString GetStoreTrainerDataFile, "General", "Path", App.Path
        End If
    End If
        

    ' Let's make sure the StoreFile folder exists
    ' By default, it should be <MY_DOCUMENTS>\StoreFiles
    Dim strSTFFolder As String
    strSTFFolder = GetStoreFileFolder(True, True)
    If (strSTFFolder = "NO_FOLDER_CREATED") Then
        ' Error: folder does not exist, or wasn't created
        MsgBox App.ProductName & " requires that you create a StoreFile folder.  Now exiting!", vbCritical, App.ProductName
        
        ' Exit with a Code 1 ERROR_NO_STF_FOLDER
        ExitProcess 1
    End If
    ' Brings up the main screen
    frmMain.Show
End Sub

' This checks for a command line switch being passed in
' Returns an integer based on results:
' 0 - no command line switch found, load as normal
' 1 - File loaded for editing /e filename.stf
' 2 - File loaded for launching /l filename.stf
Public Function CheckCommandLine(Optional CommandLine As String = "") As Integer
    
End Function

Public Sub AboutStoreTrainer()
    MsgBox App.ProductName & " v" & App.Major & "." & App.Minor & "." & App.Revision & vbCrLf & "" & vbCrLf & "Copyright (C) 2024-2025 " & App.CompanyName, vbInformation + vbOKOnly, App.ProductName
End Sub

Public Sub CreateStoreTrainerData()
    ' First, let's create folders as necessary
    Dim FSO As FileSystemObject
    Set FSO = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    If Not FSO.FolderExists(FGetSpecialFolder(CSIDL_APPDATA) & "\RaggieSoft") Then
        MkDir FGetSpecialFolder(CSIDL_APPDATA) & "\RaggieSoft"
    End If
    If Not FSO.FolderExists(FGetSpecialFolder(CSIDL_APPDATA) & "\RaggieSoft\StoreTrainer") Then
        MkDir FGetSpecialFolder(CSIDL_APPDATA) & "\RaggieSoft\StoreTrainer"
    End If
    
    ' Now, let's work on StoreTrainer data
    IniWriteValueString GetStoreTrainerDataDir & "\TStore.ini", "General", "Version", App.Major & "." & App.Minor & "." & App.Revision
    IniWriteValueString GetStoreTrainerDataDir & "\TStore.ini", "General", "Path", App.Path
End Sub

    GetStoreTrainerDataDir = FGetSpecialFolder(CSIDL_APPDATA) & "\RaggieSoft\StoreTrainer"
End Function
Public Function GetStoreTrainerDataFile() As String
    If DoesFileExist(FGetSpecialFolder(CSIDL_APPDATA) & "\RaggieSoft\StoreTrainer\TStore.ini") Then
        GetStoreTrainerDataFile = FGetSpecialFolder(CSIDL_APPDATA) & "\RaggieSoft\StoreTrainer\TStore.ini"
    Else
        GetStoreTrainerDataFile = ""
    End If
